Parametric and polygonal modeling tools for rapid iteration. Sculpting functions for high-polygon organic shapes. With generators, deformers, and spline-based workflows, you can create complex geometries with minimal technical effort.

Build precise keyframe animations, speed up character rigging with ready-made templates, and control procedural motion with Cinema 4D’s parametric animation tools. The industry standard for procedural motion design. Cloners, effectors, fields, and advanced distributions give you systematic control over complex motion. MoGraph is the ideal tool for creating everything from abstract brand animations to broadcast title sequences.

Cinema 4D is coming to iPad, enabling artists, illustrators, and motion designers to create wherever inspiration strikes. Familiar touch-first controls combined with the creative power of Cinema 4D make it easy to sketch ideas, explore forms, and bring concepts to life - whether you're starting your 3D journey or expanding an existing desktop workflow.

Earlier this year, Cinema 4D introduced new features including a Fabric Brush and expanded Cinema 4D to Windows on Arm (WoA) devices, enabling artists to take advantage of power-efficient tablets and laptops to create on the go. We also revamped its UV Editor to make working with UVs approachable and powerful, allowing artists to handle every aspect of UV creation and adjustment right inside of their favorite 3D software. New distributions for the MoGraph Cloner allow for precise placement of clones on edges, along the outline of polygons, and on the surface of objects based on their UVs. Redshift 2026.8 adds a new Scratches shader ideal for creating worn, brushed, scuffed, and damaged surfaces procedurally and can now add more realism to your sky with a larger variety of cloud types.

Cinema 4D is a professional 3D animation and modeling software for motion designers, 3D generalists, and creative studios. It combines modeling, animation, simulation, and rendering in a single application — designed for fast iteration, production reliability, and creative control. From broadcast graphics and brand animation to product visualisation and VFX, Cinema 4D is where ideas take shape in 3D. Every subscription includes a full version of the Redshift renderer, so you move from concept to final render without switching tools.

Cinema 4D is used for 3D animation, motion graphics, modeling, simulation, and rendering. It is widely used in broadcast design, advertising, product visualisation, architectural rendering, VFX, and game asset creation.

Cinema 4D is widely regarded as the most approachable professional 3D software. Its user-friendfly interface, intuitive tools, and included Cineversity training make it a strong starting point for designers and artists new to 3D.
Every Cinema 4D subscription includes Redshift GPU rendering, 5 Team Render nodes, and access to Cineversity training. Maxon One subscriptions also include ZBrush, Red Giant, Universe, and Capsules.

Cinema 4D is optimised for motion design and creative production workflows. It prioritises creative flow, ease of use, and production reliability over raw technical complexity. For a detailed comparison, see our features page.

Cinema 4D supports standard 2D image formats, 3D model formats (OBJ, FBX, Alembic, USD, glTF), CAD formats (such as STEP, CATIA or Solidworks), and native integration with Adobe After Effects or Unreal Engine via Cineware.
Cinema 4D runs on Windows (including Windows on Arm), macOS, and is coming to iPad in late 2026.
Redshift, Maxon's GPU-accelerated production renderer, is included with every Cinema 4D subscription at no additional cost, providing fast, high-quality rendering directly inside of Cinema 4D.
Maxon One is a subscription bundle that includes Cinema 4D, Redshift, ZBrush, Red Giant tools, Capsules, and Cineversity training. A complete 3D and motion design pipeline in one plan.

Cinema 4D is used for 3D animation, motion graphics, modeling, simulation, and rendering. It is widely used in broadcast design, advertising, product visualisation, architectural rendering, VFX, and game asset creation.

Cinema 4D is widely regarded as the most approachable professional 3D software. Its user-friendfly interface, intuitive tools, and included Cineversity training make it a strong starting point for designers and artists new to 3D.
What is included in a Cinema 4D subscription?
Every Cinema 4D subscription includes Redshift GPU rendering, 5 Team Render nodes, and access to Cineversity training. Maxon One subscriptions also include ZBrush, Red Giant, Universe, and Capsules.
How does Cinema 4D compare to other 3D software?

Cinema 4D is optimised for motion design and creative production workflows. It prioritises creative flow, ease of use, and production reliability over raw technical complexity. For a detailed comparison, see our features page.
What file formats does Cinema 4D support?

Cinema 4D supports standard 2D image formats, 3D model formats (OBJ, FBX, Alembic, USD, glTF), CAD formats (such as STEP, CATIA or Solidworks), and native integration with Adobe After Effects or Unreal Engine via Cineware.
Which platforms does Cinema 4D run on?
Cinema 4D runs on Windows (including Windows on Arm), macOS, and is coming to iPad in late 2026.
Is Redshift included with a Cinema 4D Subscription?
Redshift, Maxon's GPU-accelerated production renderer, is included with every Cinema 4D subscription at no additional cost, providing fast, high-quality rendering directly inside of Cinema 4D.
